govdocs-archive_org-SmithGeorgeTheJewsAt: Smith’s book on the Jews of K’ae-Fung-Foo tells of China’s old Jewry in Kaifeng town. The 1800s gospel-man’s tale blazed the trail for a little-known folk. Their prayer-house went back to 1163. The folk live on today. The book is a queer bit of far-east Jewry lore.
catholic-encyclopedia-1913-abbey-of-tong: The Encyclopedia on Tongerloo, the Belgian abbey of art and prayer. Its Last Supper copy is famed. Francis Martin Geudens recounts its story. Flemish faith in noble form. Its canons kept school for the village boys. Its printing press served the countryside.
